# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick is the JBL Charge 6.** It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and strong sound. It can also charge your phone. What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and Best Products did too. Prices in the results ranged from about $130 to $150.
- [What Hi-Fi's review, with Walmart, Amazon and Best Buy links](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- [Best Products' review, with Amazon, Walmart and Lowe's links](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Other picks by need

| Need | Speaker | Why | Where to buy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pool party volume | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, survives long immersion, and lasts 40+ hours. It's big, and the sound is muffled if you're beside or behind it. | [RTINGS, with Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart links](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) |
| 360° sound in the water | Ultimate Ears Epicboom | IP67, floats, and sounds the same from any seat. Battery is about 15 hours. Tom's Guide ranks it best overall. | [Tom's Guide, with Amazon and Newegg links](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) |
| Budget | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 | IP67, floats, and about 13–14 hours of battery. It was $65 in the Best Products review. | [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |
| Easy to carry | JBL Grip | IP68, under a pound, and about $100. Good Housekeeping's best overall for beach and pool. The mesh collects dust. | [Good Housekeeping, with Amazon, Walmart and Macy's links](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) |
| Cheapest | JBL Go 5 | Pocket-sized and IP67, about $40. Battery is only about 8 hours. | [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) |
| Big, loud and floating | Soundcore Boom 2 Plus | 100 W, IPX7, floats, and up to 20 hours of battery. At 3.8 kg it's heavy. | [Soundcore via Dealectric (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) |

**Boom 2 Plus price:** The list price is $249.99. Dealectric says code AFSC20 brings it to about $200 through 2026-12-31, and that it tested the code in Soundcore's cart. The store's checkout has the final word. Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through that link. The sources also disagree on its Bluetooth version (6.0 vs. 5.3).

## Tips for beach and pool use
- **IP ratings:** For the pool, look for IP67 or IPX7 at minimum. For the beach, pick a speaker with a dust rating too (the first number, as in IP67 or IP68). The Boom 2 Plus's IPX7 has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel.
- **Care:** Ratings don't cover corrosion from salt or chlorine. RTINGS suggests rinsing with fresh water after use, if the manufacturer allows it. Let the speaker dry fully before charging.
- **Heat:** Keep it out of direct sun, since heat can strain the battery.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want it portable or loud, I can narrow this to one pick.

Sources: [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth), [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers), [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/), [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/), [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus)
